name: Kattobi!
source:
Main character leads a normal life until one day he gets confessed to by his greatest enemy - cousin Kotetsu. Is this a mockery? Then suddenly a big earthquake starts and house gets lifted in the air. And that's only the beginning of a joyful and absurd play that protagonist and his cheerful friends set up.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公过着普通生活，直到某天宿敌堂妹小铁向他告白。这是在嘲弄他吗？随后，大地震突然发生，房子被抬到空中。这仅仅是主人公与开朗朋友们上演的欢乐荒诞剧的开端。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
